rule: SECRETS / STATIC INFRA CONFIG -> ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES. DYNAMIC LAUNCH STATE -> SUPABASE.

variables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
variables.description: OpenAI API key for future short BIT personality text. Worker and local operator only.

variables.name: SUPABASE_URL
variables.description: Supabase project URL for server-side access.

variables.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
variables.description: Supabase anon key for local operator checks.

variables.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
variables.description: Supabase service-role key. Server only: local operator, Render worker, and the Next.js server. Never expose to the browser.

variables.name: BIT_DEPLOYER_KEYPAIR_PATH
variables.description: Local filesystem path to the deployer keypair file. The key stays on the operator machine.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
variables.description: Public Supabase URL for the Next.js app on Vercel.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
variables.description: Public Supabase anon key for the Next.js app on Vercel.
